content.text:
The contact form's fields were jammed together because `.form-field` in `site/css/components.css` had `margin-bottom: 0`. I changed it to `var(--space-4)` (16px). I rendered the page afterwards and the Name, Email, Topic, Message and consent fields are evenly spaced again. The 16 functional tests pass.

The repo has a single commit, so I couldn't diff against "the last change". I picked this by inspecting the CSS and the rendered page, so if you meant something else that looks off, tell me.

One thing I left alone: the long support email in the sidebar card wraps mid-word. That comes from the existing `overflow-wrap: anywhere` rule on `.info-list dd`.

STATUS: DONE
